title: The Failing Sensor Net
logline: A system's early warning network is failing, and an unsanctioned group of engineers needs parts to fix it while the local government tries to arrest them.

roles.description: Brilliant but legally barred from practicing, fiercely protective of their makeshift team.
Pragmatic, prioritizes order and protocol over actual results.
An armed patrol vessel enforcing local regulations.
An unregistered repair bay in a hollowed-out asteroid.

public_situation: Ion storms are worsening, and the official early warning network is mysteriously offline.
private_truth: The government defunded the maintenance to hide embezzled funds. The rogue engineers are trying to fix it for free.

beats.public_change: A bounty is posted for the arrest of unregistered technicians.

missions.reason: Needs high-grade cuprite sensors to bypass the lockout without triggering alarms.
missions.private_fact: The engineer is wanted for previous acts of industrial sabotage.

beats.public_change: The official patrol intercepts a supply ship headed for the workshop.

missions.reason: Needs the confiscated diagnostic keys back from the patrol ship to finish the work.
missions.private_fact: The keys contain proof of the government's embezzlement.

beats.public_change: The ion storm intensifies. The sensor net begins rebooting.

missions.reason: The engineers need someone to keep the patrol ship busy while the final patch uploads; their own skiffs are unarmed and the government has grounded every local pilot.
missions.private_fact: The official aboard the patrol ship is offering immunity if the evidence is deleted.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot destroys the patrol and protects the upload.
resolutions.summary: The sensor net goes live. The embezzlement is exposed, causing a political crisis.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot takes the official's offer.
resolutions.summary: The net is fixed, but the corruption remains hidden. The engineers get immunity.
The sensor net stays offline. The storms cause massive damage to local infrastructure.

loose_threads.detail: The missing maintenance funds were routed through a charity shell company.
The sensor offline code matches a known criminal syndicate's electronic warfare package.

radio_hooks: Local engineers claim to be repairing sensor net; authorities urge caution.
Ion storm warnings disabled due to 'technical difficulties'.

voice_direction.rogue_engineer: Fast-talking, deeply tired, intensely passionate about their work.
voice_direction.sys_official: Calm, condescending, uses bureaucratic jargon to threaten.
